question: Worker timing and placement at equal spend; pick-rule ablation

metric_definitions.delta_vs_none: expected share − that of no campaign (same world)
metric_definitions.worker_mean_degree: mean degree of the workers bought (per world)
metric_definitions.best_matched: ORACLE: region with the highest true mean P for b when buying
metric_definitions.pick rules: experiment-side, outside the game rules (R22 = random)

test_families.timing: front vs even, front vs late, even vs late × 3 placements × 2 K (18), Wilcoxon + McNemar, Holm
test_families.placement: best_matched vs largest, proportional vs largest, best_matched vs proportional × 3 timings × 2 K (18)
test_families.amount: K = 10 vs K = 4 for each of the 9 timing × placement arms (9)
test_families.pick_rule: sample10 vs random and top_degree vs random × 3 pick arms (6)

deviations: Two spend levels K ∈ {4, 10} workers (the plan fixes only 'equal total spend').
The pick-rule arms replace R22 through x_batch's pick_fn hook (experiment-side, outside the game rules); the 'random' pick_fn reproduces the library pick bit for bit (checked).

parity.cell: K = 10 even / proportional (random pick) and K = 10 front / proportional (top_degree pick)
